questions.prompt: Who was the first Emperor of Rome?
questions.fact: He avoided the title of king entirely, preferring first citizen, which let him hold power without provoking the Senate.

questions.prompt: Which layer of the Earth is liquid?
questions.fact: Its churning generates the planet's magnetic field, which is why Mars lost most of its atmosphere when its core cooled.

questions.prompt: In American football, how many points is a safety worth?
questions.fact: It is the only score awarded to the defending team, and the conceding side must then kick the ball away.

questions.prompt: Which reality format sends contestants to a remote location to be voted off?
questions.fact: The format originated in Sweden, where the first series ended in controversy after a contestant's death by suicide.

questions.prompt: Which is the largest lake in South America?
questions.fact: It is connected to the sea, so whether it counts as a lake at all is a matter of definition.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel A Room with a View?
questions.fact: He published no novels for the last forty-five years of his life, though he wrote one that appeared posthumously.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym OCR do?
options: Converts images of text into text
questions.fact: Early systems were trained on a single typeface, which is why documents had to be printed in a specific font.
